summary: Wired four new chat-agent tools (run_probe/grade_answer/build_plan/advance_lesson) to the existing LearningService/PlansService/TeachService so the model drives the Socratic arc (probe -> plan-as-mermaid -> teach one step -> check -> remediate); added the static PHASE_PLAYBOOK block to make_system_prompt; passed conn/session_id into ToolContext; extended tests/test_tools_loop.py.
final_report: T76 done, uncommitted per batch policy. WHAT LANDED: (1) app/llm/tools.py - four new tool schemas alongside the existing six (all carry the reserved status prop via _fn): run_probe{}, grade_answer{question_id required, choice_index integer, idk bool default false}, build_plan{}, advance_lesson{passed_check boolean required}; available_tools now exposes the four unconditionally (_LEARNING_TOOLS frozenset unioned into enabled); execute_tool dispatches them to new handlers with lazy service imports (cycle-safe) and a shared guard returning {error:unavailable_in_context} when ctx.conn is None. run_probe calls LearningService.generate_probe and returns {phase:probe,count,questions:[{id,question,options,difficulty}]} - correct_index/explanation/topic/status stripped; stored options keep the trailing 'I don't know' row the server appends. grade_answer returns answer_quiz's inner result dict VERBATIM ({question_id,outcome,correct_index,explanation,probe_complete,retry_allowed,next_node,check_due}) - post-answer grading feedback, same info /answer returns publicly. build_plan returns {phase:plan,nodes:[{node_key,title,depends_on,status,position}]}. advance_lesson: passed_check=false does NOT advance - routes via SessionService.set_phase('remediate') (service-owned transition) and returns {advanced:false,node:{node_key,title},check_due:false,session_phase:'remediate'}; otherwise if session.phase=='plan' it bridges plan->first node via the EXISTING PlansService.approve transition and returns {advanced:true,node,check_due:false,session_phase:'teach'}; otherwise plain TeachService.advance(session_id) (default reset_check=False), returning {lesson_complete:true} when node is None or phase=='complete', else {advanced:true,node:{node_key,title},check_due,session_phase} plus check_question {id,question,options} (correct_index stripped) appended whenever advance reported check_due, generated by awaiting LearningService.generate_check. (2) app/llm/messages.py (+27) - PHASE_PLAYBOOK constant with the mandated TEACHING ARC text, injected in make_system_prompt right AFTER the lesson-state insertion and BEFORE [DOCUMENT EXCERPTS], i.e. always present; build_lesson_state_block untouched. (3) turn.py (+4) - ToolContext dataclass gains conn: Any=None and session_id: str='' (defaults keep all existing constructions valid); the turn() construction site now passes conn=self.conn, session_id=session_id. (4) tests/test_tools_loop.py - gate test updated for 10 tools (names_without==9) plus seven new scripted tests: conn guard x4 tools, run_probe strip+phase persistence, grade_answer passthrough shape incl correct/idk/incorrect + probe_complete transitions, build_plan stripped nodes, plan->teach first-node entry via bridge, failed-check remediation routing WITHOUT advancing (node stays current), and check_due appending a stripped check_question. SERVICE-SIGNATURE SURPRISES: (a) TeachService.advance raises ValueError unless phase=='teach', but PHASE_PLAYBOOK mandates advance_lesson immediately after build_plan (phase=='plan') - without a bridge that first call would error every time; bridged through PlansService.approve, which is precisely the existing plan->first-node transition (marks first pending current, phase='teach', nodes_since_check=0). Flagging because the task's dispatch spec described only the TeachService.advance path. (b) LearningService.answer_quiz and TeachService.advance are SYNC (no await) while generate_probe/generate_plan/generate_check are async (awaited) - handlers match. (c) session_phase on the check_due path reports advance's own snapshot ('teach') per spec literalism; the DB phase is 'check' by then since generate_check set it - asserted as such in the test. VERIFICATION: python -m compileall over the four files clean; pytest tests/test_tools_loop.py -q -> 17 passed in 2.06s; extra targeted regression pytest tests/test_api_chat_sse.py::test_second_turn_system_prompt_carries_lesson_state -q -> 1 passed (system-prompt change is additive). LSP diagnostics observed during edits are the pre-existing TurnMixin/httpx-stub noise already recorded by T73/T75 - none introduced by this change. No commit made (batch policy); working tree diff vs HEAD 799852b touches exactly my four declared files.

Design decisions beyond the literal spec text, recorded for Orpheus: remediation routing uses SessionService.set_phase('remediate') through TeachService's composed sessions instance (services own all transitions; no parallel state machine, no new tables); plan-phase entry bridges via PlansService.approve rather than bypassing services; 'advanced' boolean added to both non-complete advance_lesson responses so the model can narrate stay-vs-move unambiguously.
